title: Canadian government innovation office candidates

selectedGap.reason: No published or pending government innovation office organization is represented in the local coverage view.

guardrailNotes: All three records remain private candidate_pending objects until a human reviewer separately accepts and publishes them through Admin Review.
IDEaS and DRDC already exist in the demand model as public demand issuers; these organization candidates intentionally preserve that cross-model identity warning for reviewer resolution.
Government program activity is public ecosystem evidence, not proof of procurement eligibility, endorsement, customer interest, or classified defence demand.
Ottawa coordinates are map-placement approximations: DRDC uses an official Ottawa address, while IDEaS and Innovative Solutions Canada use conservative regional placement that reviewers must confirm.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Innovative Solutions Canada fills the government-innovation-office gap with strong official evidence for a national program that helps federal departments articulate operational problems, fund Canadian SME research and prototype development, test pre-commercial innovations in operational settings, and explore commercialization pathways. Reviewers should confirm whether True North Map should represent the initiative as an organization profile or only as an ISED-operated program, and should verify the regional Ottawa map placement before publication.

duplicateCheck.note: No Innovative Solutions Canada, ISC, Solutions innovatrices Canada, stable-slug, normalized-name, or pending organization match was found in the canonical production organization and private candidate coverage inspected for this run.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: ISED describes Innovative Solutions Canada as a federal initiative that stimulates Canadian technology research, development, commercialization, and testing while helping improve government operations.
The official program overview supports a mandate to reduce development and testing barriers for Canadian startups and SMEs through Challenge and Testing streams tied to public-sector needs.
The Challenge Stream helps departments define unmet operational problems and outcomes, sponsor feasibility and prototype work, and consider pathways to acquire market-ready innovations.
The Testing Stream enables eligible public organizations to test Canadian prototypes in operational settings, provide user feedback, and potentially consider commercialized solutions.
The official page is published within the Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada program structure and identifies Innovative Solutions Canada as a federal initiative.
The Ottawa coordinate is a conservative regional placement based on the operating department's official Ottawa presence; it is not asserted as an exact Innovative Solutions Canada office address.

organization.name: Innovative Solutions Canada
organization.description: Federal innovation initiative that helps Canadian startups and small and medium businesses develop, test, and commercialize new technologies against public-sector operational needs through challenge funding and real-world prototype testing.

candidates.reviewerRationale: IDEaS is a strong candidate for the government-innovation-office lane because official DND evidence documents a dedicated defence innovation program, long-term investment, five distinct innovation mechanisms, direct use of DND and CAF guidance, and a mandate to build Canada's defence innovation ecosystem. Reviewers must resolve the deliberate cross-model identity: IDEaS already exists as a published demand issuer, and this candidate would add an organization profile for the same public identity. The regional Ottawa map placement also requires confirmation.

duplicateCheck.note: No IDEaS organization or pending organization candidate was found. A published demand issuer with the same identity and slug exists in a separate model; the reviewer rationale flags that intentional cross-model representation for explicit review.

sources.title: Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security
sources.locator: Program overview, opportunities, and official navigation
sources.summary: The official Department of National Defence program page identifies IDEaS as Canada's defence innovation program and provides the canonical route to program opportunities, challenges, elements, and reporting.

sources.title: How Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security Works
sources.locator: Investment, mandate, DND position, and five innovation elements
sources.summary: Official DND guidance describes IDEaS as a long-term defence and security innovation program that mobilizes Canadian innovators from early concepts through real-world testing using Competitive Projects, Innovation Networks, Contests, Sandboxes, and Test Drives.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: DND describes IDEaS as a defence and security innovation program that mobilizes Canadian innovators through public challenges, development support, collaboration, and real-world testing.
The official page says IDEaS improves DND access to Canadian innovators, enhances defence capability, supports economic impact, and builds a national defence innovation ecosystem.
IDEaS identifies Competitive Projects as a phased development-funding mechanism intended to advance defence and security technologies along the innovation continuum.
The official program overview identifies Test Drives as a mechanism through which the Canadian Armed Forces evaluates technologies in relevant real-world settings.
The program states that IDEaS is positioned within DND and uses DND and CAF leadership guidance together with defence-science expertise, including DRDC support.
The Ottawa coordinate is a conservative regional map placement for a national DND-operated program; it is not an exact IDEaS office address and requires reviewer confirmation.

organization.name: Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security
organization.description: Department of National Defence innovation program that mobilizes Canadian researchers and companies through defence and security challenges, phased development support, networks, contests, sandboxes, and Canadian Armed Forces technology testing.

profileData.mandate: Improve the Department of National Defence's access to Canadian innovators, accelerate defence and security concepts toward testing, enhance defence capability, create economic impact, and build Canada's defence innovation ecosystem.
profileData.crossModelIdentity: A demand issuer with the same IDEaS identity is already published; this organization candidate is a separate profile proposal and not a duplicate published organization.
profileData.evidencePosture: Official DND program evidence strongly supports the mandate and mechanisms. Reviewers must decide whether the same identity should exist in both organization and demand-issuer models and confirm the regional map placement.

programs.name: Competitive Projects
programs.summary: IDEaS funding mechanism that supports phased development of Canadian defence and security concepts and technologies as they move along the innovation continuum.

programs.name: Test Drives
programs.programType: Canadian Armed Forces operational technology testing
programs.summary: IDEaS mechanism that gives the Canadian Armed Forces a structured way to put selected technologies through relevant testing and provide operationally informed evaluation.

relationships.publicSummary: IDEaS is positioned within the Department of National Defence and draws on DND and Canadian Armed Forces leadership guidance together with defence-science expertise, including support from DRDC.

candidates.reviewerRationale: DRDC is a credible government-innovation-office candidate because official sources identify it as Canada's defence science, technology, and innovation leader, administrator of the Defence and Security Science and Technology program, operator of national research capabilities, and a collaboration and technology-transfer partner for government, industry, academia, and allies. Reviewers must decide whether government_innovation_office or research_test_centre is the better primary kind and resolve the deliberate cross-model identity because DRDC already exists as a published demand issuer.

duplicateCheck.note: No DRDC organization or pending organization candidate was found. A published demand issuer with the same identity and slug exists in a separate model; the reviewer rationale flags that intentional cross-model representation for explicit review.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: DRDC's official profile identifies it as Canada's defence science, technology, and innovation leader providing technical solutions and advice to DND and the Canadian Armed Forces.

The official profile supports a national mandate spanning defence science and technology, operational and policy advice, research centres, innovation programs, and work with domestic and allied partners.
DRDC is identified as the DND science and technology organization responsible for administering DSST across eight strategic focus areas for defence and security research, development, and innovation.
DRDC's official profile and services are presented as the national defence science and technology organization serving the Department of National Defence and Canadian Armed Forces.

The official contact page lists DRDC's National Defence Headquarters presence and Ottawa Research Centre in Ottawa, Ontario; the map uses the Ottawa city centroid rather than an exact building coordinate.
